newsitem.title: CHINA: China to boost crude oil processing capacity.
newsitem.headline: China to boost crude oil processing capacity.

text.p: China plans to boost its crude oil refining capacity to more than 300 million tonnes by 2010, the Financial News said on Tuesday.
The annual capacity rose to 220.3 million tonnes in 1996 from 104 million tonnes in 1983, with an average annual growth of 5.8 percent, the newspaper said.
Annual ethylene production capacity was expected to reach about five million tonnes by 2000, and eight to 10 million tonnes by 2010, it said.
Annual ethylene capacity rose to 623,000 tonnes in 1996 from 394,000 tonnes in 1983, with an average rate of increase of 15.2 percent a year, it said but gave no further details.
